content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the detailed CEN No. 05/2026 will be eligible to apply. The detailed notification will provide post-wise qualification requirements for different Paramedical Categories.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RRB website. Open the RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 notification section. Read the detailed CEN No. 05/2026 carefully. Click on the online application link. Register using your required details. Fill out the application form correctly. Upload required documents and photographs. Submit the application form before the last date. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Railway Recruitment Boards for various Paramedical Category posts under CEN No. 05/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 560 tentative vacancies have been announced for various Paramedical Category posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application start date for RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process is tentatively scheduled to start from 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The tentative last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026 up to 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q5. What are the posts available under RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for various posts under Paramedical Categories. The detailed post-wise vacancies and names will be available in the detailed CEN notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay level for RRB Paramedical posts?
faq.answer: The pay level for Paramedical Category posts ranges from Pay Level 3 to Pay Level 7 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission.
